correctness.rationale: Analytic clock-race identity follows by Stieltjes inversion and even log-rate mixing density. Bounded harmonic recurrence has root 2-sqrt(3). Two-step reset-then-right event yields exponential N tail; predictable counting gives expected N=2(1+sqrt(3)). Conditional on marks and signs the durations are independent with power-tail constants alpha and beta shares; summable union bound makes stopped-sum tail derivation uniform. Tonelli gives exact mean and sharp sum-of-indices critical boundary. Exact transform follows from an inhomogeneous lattice recurrence. Standalone package verifier passed 943 complementary checks; none substitutes for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural finite-site search problem associated with newly studied competing-clock resetting is completely characterized in the heavy-tail regime. The result supplies an exact nontrivial first-arrival constant, a sharp finite-mean boundary, an arrival transform and a marked long-delay attribution that allows one to distinguish whether an exceptional search time arises during a jump or a reset. The fair-clock identity makes the event-count constant independent of both distinct fractional orders and settles a concrete balance ambiguity, beyond routine min-clock tail evaluation.
